title: Speed Handheld Cooling Fan With Superconducting Ice Pack, 3000mAh Rechargeable Portable Mini Air Cooler With LCD Display For Summer Outdoor Travel
body_html:
Compact but mighty. Cooling you down in this hot summer and streamlining your life, our handheld fan with ice cooler designs with a superconducting ice pack and 100 speed fan cooling. You can short press Fan Button to set up fixed fan speed or long press to customize coolness from speed 1 to 100 freely. The embedded ice pack works as a portable mini refrigerator, which chills to to 42.8℉instantly and allows you to enjoy ice therapy anywhere anytime. Built in a 3000mAh rechargeable battery, provides up to 6 hours of continuous cooling. Feature a HD digital display, easy to read and use. An ideal companion for summer cooling on the go!

Features:

 

  • 100 Speed Handheld Fan: Small size with big function. This handheld fan with ice cooler provide 2 ways of fan cooling. You can short press Fan Button to set up fixed fan speed or long press to customize coolness from 1 to 100 speed freely. Powered by high-speed brushless motor, this portable cooling fan allows you to enjoy cooling from gentle 2.9m/s refreshing air to a turbo 4.7m/s airflow for intense heat.

 

  • Advanced Superconducting Ice Pack Cooling: Featured with advanced superconducting ice pack cooling technology, this mini handheld fan works as a portable mini refrigerator, which chills to to 42.8℉instantly and allows you to enjoy ice therapy anywhere anytime. Just short press Ice Button after pressing Fan Button and get an instant relief from hot summer!

 

  • 6H Cooling Time & 3000mAh Rechargeable Battery: Built in a 3000mAh rechargeable battery, this portable personal fan allows you to enjoy up to 6 hours of continuous cooling on a single full charge.

 

  • Mini & Portable Fan: Enjoy the breeze on the go with our high speed handheld fan. Ideal for walking, travelling and more. Mini and lightweight, easy to carry everywhere.

 

  • Smart LCD Display: Our handheld fan with cooling compress is easy to use. Feature a HD digital display to show the fan speed and battery level in real time.
